name: Saudi Cement Company
summary: Saudi Cement Company manufactures and sells cement and related products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers cement clinkers, sulfate resistant cement, and ordinary Portland products. It provides its products to construction projects, such as highways, bridges, airports, seaports, railways, metros, and various housing and commercial projects. The company also export its cement and clinker products to Africa, East Asia, and internationally. Saudi Cement Company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
